in_sanskrit.name: निवेदिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is offered or dedicated

in_marathi.name: Niveditha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niveditha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'nivedaya', meaning 'to offer' or 'to dedicate'. It is believed that the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, bestows her blessings on a child given this name. The name is also associated with the god Vishnu and the act of offering or dedicating oneself to a higher power.
